section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the relationship between early positive memories and disordered eating in a sample of 490 women. The study used path analysis to test whether social safeness and body appreciation mediate the association between early warm and safe memories and eating psychopathology, while controlling for BMI. The model explained 51% of the variance in eating psychopathology and demonstrated good fit to the data.
